title: Grateful Dead Live at Buckeye Lake Music Center on 1991-06-09
lineage: Tascam DA-20 MKII > Roland SRC-2 > Mac Mini optical input > Audacity 2.1 > WAV @ 48kHz; Edited & mastered in Audacity by Joe Noel: WAV > Flac48
source: flac16/48; taper unknown: FOB Schoeps CMC32s spaced 8 ft > Tao Research PS > M1000 cables > Panasonic SV255 with 6'3" stands; John Ammons

ai_review.summary: Audience tape with noticeable crackle captures a beloved show highlighted by an enthusiastic St. Stephen.
ai_review.review: The recording is an audience source that suffers from some crackling and limited fidelity, but it conveys the energy of a favorite concert for the reviewer. The performance itself is praised, especially the moment when the crowd shouted to Phil during St. Stephen, making it a memorable highlight despite the rough tape quality.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review; reviewer gave 4 stars and expressed strong positive feelings about the show, but mentions audible crackle which lowers the recording score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Noticeable crackling and ambient crowd noise; captures atmosphere but lacks clarity of a soundboard.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Enthusiastic audience interaction, with a memorable Phil moment during St. Stephen; overall enjoyment outweighs tape imperfections.

band_member_comments.Phil: Crowd shouted to Phil for St. Stephen, indicating strong audience connection.
